items.name: Claims Before the Accident
items.purpose: Meridian holds indemnity schedules dated before the described handling incidents. A supervised split-sample experiment can test the measurement regime without risking a worker.
invariants: Acquired evidence is not complete Truth.
No generic prophecy, mind control or corporate monster kill.
Past circulation, injury and exclusion cannot be erased by late settlement.
generationEnvelope: Ordinary descriptions only; fixed evidence, deadlines, power and rights cannot be invented.

canon.entry: After the opening Breach, accept an independent consented mandate.
canon.truth: P7_PRIVATE_ACCIDENT: the instrument binds unresolved handling alternatives to indemnity records. Its backdated-looking specificity is produced by a registration regime, not knowledge of every future accident. Existing injuries cannot be undone.
stakes: On day twelve the insurer standardizes unresolved categories unless use is restricted; excluded applicants then need individual review.
Protect current people while retaining incompatible evidence.
pressures: On day twelve the insurer standardizes unresolved categories unless use is restricted; excluded applicants then need individual review.
routes: Independent community, physical or controlled comparison route
interventions: Isolate two inert samples, stop the live conveyor and agree custody before any trial.
consequences: Unmeasured alternatives retained for review. Slower assessments and funding burden.
Audit and compensation rights. New reporting duties and institutional power.
Independent scrutiny of measurement. Publicity and sample custody burden.
Future review possible. Categories may lock without claimant input.
canon.eastbankContribution: Controlled evidence challenges passive-measurement explanations; it does not establish universal foreknowledge or Eastbank intent.
revelationPredicates: No single archive or settlement establishes every predicate.
reentry: Late legal review and retained custody remain available.
Withdrawal does not erase acquired support or clock pressure.
canon.orderSafety: Other Signature completions are not prerequisites.
canon.failureContinuity: Locked categories and denied applications are not erased by later regulation; preserved duplicate samples permit a review route.

sources.text: Applicant-authorized schedule predates the handling incident and specifies one of two then-viable damage categories. It is not a record of an injury already observed.
In a stopped-conveyor split-sample trial, registering one supported category makes the alternative harder to retain. No injured person or settled event is changed.
The industrial client retains a separately sealed schedule with the same early issue time and two initially supported alternatives.
Independent unregistered controls retain both alternatives; the signed protocol limits the inference to this apparatus and these unresolved samples.
